name: phased-code-review
title_zh: 几千文件分七轮审完，断点续审不丢进度
tagline_zh: Windows 服务、RPC/IPC、守护进程、外部集成全查一遍。专治「审到一半超 token」——每轮成果落盘。
tagline_en: Windows services, RPC/IPC, daemons, external integrations—all covered. Token limits won't lose progress: each.
desc_en: Systematic, resumable, multi-phase deep review of a large or multi-component codebase (thousands of files; Windows services, RPC/IPC, daemons, libraries, external integrations) to dig out technical, logical, security, concurrency, lifecycle, resource-leak and cross-file bugs — engineered so token/session limits never lose progress. Use when the user wants to audit or review an entire codebase or a
why_zh: 把大代码库拆成可恢复的七个阶段，每阶段独立产出报告。跨文件、并发、资源泄漏等深坑逐层筛。
why_en: Splits a huge codebase into seven resumable phases, each with its own report. Digs cross-file, concurrency, and leak bugs layer.
limit_zh: 只审本地已有代码，不接 GitHub 链接；需用户逐轮确认范围，不能全自动跑完；产物是分析报告，不直接改代码或生成补丁。
limit_en: Local code only—no GitHub URLs. Requires per-phase scope confirmation; not fully autonomous. Output is analysis reports, not patches or code edits.
title_en: 7-phase codebase review that resumes where you left off
